verdict.rationale: Paychex documents that it offers 401(k) benefits and that benefits can be added without switching systems or moving data. A 'Benefit Administration: Recurring Deduction' API use case suggests deductions recur through payroll, but nothing explicitly states that retirement contributions sync automatically each pay run. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll 401(k) contribution syncing, details on contribution and employer-match handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll

citations.quote: Offer 401(k) and comprehensive health insurance benefits.
Add benefits, time tracking, or HR tools when you need them, without switching systems, moving data, or retraining your team.
